-   **Rarity note:** Migratory bird found throughout Florida in open and semi-open habitats with trees.

## Natural history notes

A large black songbird characterized by its glossy black plumage, stout bill, broad wings, and loud cawing calls. In Florida, it is found in forests, pine flatwoods, agricultural areas, wetlands, suburbs, parks, roadsides, and other open or semi-open habitats with trees for nesting and roosting. It is highly adaptable and omnivorous, feeding on insects, seeds, fruits, carrion, eggs, small animals, and human-associated food, often foraging on the ground or in small groups.
